description: GOIF Vertical B evidence records for MU-premium-visa, CV-remote-work-visa, NA-digital-nomad-visa

records.claim: The Mauritius Premium Visa allows foreign nationals to live and work remotely from Mauritius for up to one year, renewable. Eligibility requirements: valid passport, proof of remote employment or self-employment with income sourced outside Mauritius, proof of accommodation in Mauritius, and a clean criminal record. The visa is issued by the Economic Development Board (EDB) Mauritius. There is no minimum income threshold published by the EDB, but applicants must demonstrate sufficient financial means to support themselves. The Premium Visa is not a work permit — holders may not work for a Mauritius-based employer.
records.methodology: Primary source — EDB Mauritius official portal reviewed for Premium Visa eligibility criteria.

records.claim: No fixed minimum income threshold is published by the EDB for the Mauritius Premium Visa. Applicants must demonstrate sufficient financial means to support themselves during their stay. The visa application fee is approximately USD 0 (no fee published as of October 2026). The indicative setup cost including initial accommodation deposit and travel is approximately USD 1,500-2,500. Mauritius uses the Mauritian Rupee (MUR); the cost of living is moderate by international standards. Remote workers earning USD 2,000-3,000/month would comfortably meet the financial means requirement.
records.methodology: Primary source — EDB Mauritius portal reviewed. No fixed threshold published; indicative figures based on Mauritius cost-of-living data.

records.claim: Cape Verde introduced a Remote Work Visa (Visto de Trabalho Remoto) to attract digital nomads and remote workers. Eligibility requirements: valid passport, proof of remote employment or freelance income sourced outside Cape Verde, proof of accommodation, health insurance, and clean criminal record. The visa is issued for an initial period of 6 months, renewable for up to 2 years. Holders may not work for a Cape Verde-based employer. The visa is administered by the Cape Verde Immigration Service (SEF-CV).
records.methodology: Primary source — SEF-CV official portal reviewed for Remote Work Visa eligibility criteria. Confidence medium due to limited English-language official documentation.

records.claim: Cape Verde requires proof of sufficient income to support yourself during your stay. The commonly cited minimum income threshold for the Remote Work Visa is approximately EUR 1,500/month (approximately USD 1,650/month). Cape Verde uses the Cape Verdean Escudo (CVE), pegged to the Euro. The cost of living is low by European standards. The visa application fee is approximately EUR 60-90. The indicative setup cost including visa fee, initial accommodation and travel is approximately USD 1,200-2,000.
records.methodology: Primary source — SEF-CV portal reviewed. EUR 1,500/month threshold is the commonly cited figure; exact published threshold not confirmed in English-language official documentation.

records.claim: Namibia introduced a Digital Nomad Visa to attract remote workers and freelancers. Eligibility requirements: valid passport, proof of remote employment or freelance income sourced outside Namibia, proof of accommodation, health insurance covering Namibia, and clean criminal record. The visa is issued for an initial period of 6 months, extendable. Holders may not work for a Namibia-based employer. The visa is administered by the Ministry of Home Affairs, Immigration, Safety and Security (MHAISS).
records.sourceAuthority: Ministry of Home Affairs, Immigration, Safety and Security
records.methodology: Primary source — MHAISS official portal reviewed. Confidence medium due to limited published detail on the digital nomad visa program.

records.claim: Namibia requires proof of sufficient income to support yourself during your stay. The commonly cited minimum income threshold for the Digital Nomad Visa is approximately USD 2,000/month. Namibia uses the Namibian Dollar (NAD), pegged to the South African Rand. The cost of living is moderate. The visa application fee is approximately NAD 1,500 (approximately USD 80). The indicative setup cost including visa fee, initial accommodation and travel is approximately USD 1,500-2,500.
records.sourceAuthority: Ministry of Home Affairs, Immigration, Safety and Security
records.methodology: Primary source — MHAISS portal reviewed. USD 2,000/month threshold is the commonly cited figure; exact published threshold not confirmed in official documentation.
